label: Selfie
description: Kinds of selfie: how the photographer holds the camera on themselves, alone, as a pair or in a group.
notes: Selfies belong here, named by how the camera is held (at arm's length, in a mirror, on a stick) and who is in the frame. The people facet says how many people each one shows (one, two, a group), so a prompt with one person is never offered a group selfie. camera.shot_size owns framing distance, camera.angle owns viewpoint, and camera.film_look owns the camera itself. Values are named shots with an article, read after “framed as”.

values.look: The photographer’s face and shoulders fill the near foreground, often with an outstretched arm entering an edge.
A phone held close fills the frame with the face, slightly wide, with little of the place behind.
The phone is held above eye level, so the face tilts up toward the lens and the body narrows below it.
Two faces lean close together near the lens, one person's arm reaching toward the camera.
Several faces crowd close to the camera, with the person holding it nearest the foreground.
A mirror reflection shows the photographer from the waist up, with the phone visible in one hand.
A tall mirror shows the photographer’s entire body and outfit, with the phone visible in the reflection.
Two people stand together in a mirror's reflection, one of them holding the phone up in view.
The camera sits at the end of a pole, taking in more of the people and the place around them, the stick sometimes in view.
